name: PFOA
note: Legacy long-chain PFAS; extensively studied relative to most PFAS.

name: PFOS
note: Legacy long-chain PFAS; persistent and widely studied.

name: BPA
note: Widely studied bisphenol with estrogen-receptor and other endocrine research.

name: BPS
note: Common BPA substitute with a smaller evidence base than BPA.

name: DEHP
note: High-molecular-weight phthalate historically used in flexible PVC.

name: DBP
note: Phthalate studied for reproductive and developmental endocrine effects.

name: PCB-153
note: Persistent non-dioxin-like PCB congener often measured in biomonitoring.

name: p,p'-DDE
note: Persistent DDT metabolite with anti-androgenic research literature.

name: BDE-47
note: PBDE congener frequently studied in exposure and thyroid-related research.
